mapper.sql: e.event_id, e.title, e.location, e.description, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.owner_id, e.group_id, e.status, e.created_at, o.display_name AS owner_name, g.name AS group_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participant x WHERE x.event_id = e.event_id AND x.status = 'ACCEPTED') AS accepted_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participant x WHERE x.event_id = e.event_id AND x.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_comment c WHERE c.event_id = e.event_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_event (title, location, description, start_time, end_time, owner_id, group_id, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{location}, #{description}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{ownerId}, #{groupId}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM schedule_event e JOIN sys_user o ON o.user_id = e.owner_id LEFT JOIN user_group g ON g.group_id = e.group_id WHERE e.event_id = #{id}

SELECT , p.status AS my_status FROM schedule_event e JOIN sys_user o ON o.user_id = e.owner_id LEFT JOIN user_group g ON g.group_id = e.group_id LEFT JOIN event_participant p ON p.event_id = e.event_id AND p.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.owner_id = #{userId} OR p.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.start_time, e.event_id
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_event SET status = #{status} WHERE event_id = #{id}
UPDATE event_participant SET status = 'PENDING', responded_at = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id <> #{ownerId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.username, u.display_name FROM event_participant p JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY p.invited_by IS NOT NULL, p.invited_at, p.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_participant (event_id, user_id, status, invited_by, responded_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{invitedBy}, IF(#{status} = 'ACCEPTED', NOW(), NULL)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), invited_by = VALUES(invited_by), invited_at = NOW(), responded_at = VALUES(responded_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE event_participant SET status = #{status}, responded_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId}
